items.title: Visa expands AI cybersecurity tools and advisory services
items.summary: Visa (NYSE:V) has expanded its cybersecurity offering with an updated version of its open-source Visa Vulnerability Agentic Harness (VVAH) framework and the introduction of three advisory services through its Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA) division. The developments broaden Visa’s use of artificial intelligence in cybersecurity, extending VVAH beyond vulnerability detection to include remediation and validation capabilities.

items.title: President Donald Trump's Investment Team Purchased Up to $5 Million in 3 High-Flying Stocks in June, According to His Financial Disclosure
items.summary: Among the president's more than 1,000 trades disclosed in June were purchases ranging from $1 million to $5 million in three industry-leading businesses -- one of which has rallied 85,000% since its IPO.

items.title: Visa (V) Launches Unified Card Present Payment Platform For Global Merchants
items.summary: Visa (NYSE:V) has partnered with Bluefin to launch a unified card-present payment acceptance solution for global merchants. The new offering combines advanced payment security and device management in a single platform for in-person transactions. The solution is aimed at simplifying deployment of secure payment infrastructure and reducing compliance scope for enterprise users.
